name: Grafana Alerts
author: dDan4a
description: Firing Grafana alerts in the Omarchy bar: severity badge, alert list, desktop notifications, one-key silence. Works in demo mode without a Grafana instance.

barWidget.description: Firing Grafana-managed alerts with notifications and silences

schema.label: Grafana URL
schema.description: For example https://grafana.example.com. Leave empty for demo mode.

schema.label: Service account token file
schema.description: A file holding only the token (chmod 600). The token is kept out of shell.json.
